subject: Data Engineering
title: The Future of Data Lakes
description: A 60-second lesson on The Future of Data Lakes.

hook.text: Data lakes started as cheap dumps for raw data. They're evolving into the foundation of modern data platforms.

buildup.text: Table formats, governance tools, and unified catalogs are transforming lakes into reliable, queryable platforms.

discovery.text: Open formats like Iceberg and open catalogs mean data is no longer trapped in one vendor's ecosystem.

twist.text: The lake and the warehouse are merging. The future isn't choosing between them — it's one unified platform.

climax.text: The lakehouse won the architecture debate. Now the question is which table format and catalog will dominate.

punchline.text: The lake grew up. The warehouse opened up. They're becoming one.

quiz.question: What is the emerging trend for data lakes and warehouses?
options: They are converging into unified lakehouse platforms
Data lakes are being completely abandoned
Warehouses are replacing all lake storage
